PRIMARY_FAMILY.membership: IMMUTABLE — frozen by claim id in FORWARD_HUB_REGISTRATION_V1
PRIMARY_FAMILY.overlap: RETAINED; no disjoint partition; the shared map preserves the dependence

FIRST_LOOK_TRIGGER.evaluation_cadence: ONLY at the end of a COMPLETED forward calendar month. No mid-month evaluation.
FIRST_LOOK_TRIGGER.condition_a: >= 6 complete eligible forward calendar months accrued

condition_b.NAMING_RULE: X_positive_episode_n is NOT positive_n. positive_n means the Y-AVAILABLE positive denominator used in the historical inference. The trigger must not touch any Y value and must not touch Y AVAILABILITY.

on_pass: freeze the forward date/session window at that month-end
FIRST_LOOK_TRIGGER.BACKSTOP: if condition_b has still not passed at the end of 12 complete forward calendar months, freeze the window there and run anyway

LOOKS.rule: any subsequent look is a NEW registration with NEW provenance, not a continuation

indicative_calendar.note: indicative only — the actual look is governed by condition_b

DEFINEDNESS.per_member: theta_j is DEFINED iff both the Y-available positive group and the Y-available nonpositive group satisfy the frozen theta computation's minimum mathematical definedness requirements
DEFINEDNESS.NO_FORWARD_Y_FLOOR: no forward Y-based n>=100 floor is introduced. The n>=100 criterion belongs ONLY to the X-side first-look trigger.
DEFINEDNESS.handling: undefined member theta_j are OMITTED from median_j, identically in OBSERVED and in every SCALE and every NULL draw
DEFINEDNESS.ESTIMAND_STATEMENT: DEFINEDNESS CHANGES THE REALIZED HUB COMPOSITION. THETA_h is therefore an availability/definedness-conditioned hub effect among the members whose theta_j is defined. Its difference from the full registered-member hub estimand has UNKNOWN DIRECTION. No upward or downward bias direction is asserted.
DEFINEDNESS.VALIDITY_STATEMENT: applying the identical dropping rule inside the null is NECESSARY but NOT SUFFICIENT for validity. Validity continues to rest on the frozen permutation invariance assumption and on fixed-family stability.

FIXED_HUB_STABILITY_GATE.trigger: hub h fails its minimum-defined threshold in OBSERVED or in ANY required SCALE/NULL draw
consequence: T_h = -inf inside the family max-stat machinery
FIXED_HUB_STABILITY_GATE.PROHIBITION: the hub MAY NOT disappear from k_hub = 4. The family dimension is FIXED at 4 in every draw. Variable-dimension max-stat is forbidden.

DRAW_BUDGET.rationale: a NEW k=4 forward family, frozen BEFORE forward Y. 500 SCALE draws stabilise the robust c_h/s_h studentisation better than 200. Not raised further: 0.0001 resolution is sufficient for a 4-hub confirmation; extreme p-value ranking is not an objective.
DRAW_BUDGET.NOT_A_RERANKING: this budget may NOT be used to re-rank the 265 floor-bound historical claims. B_NULL for the historical family remains 1800.

STATISTIC.THETA_h_obs: median over defined j in hub h of theta_j_obs
STATISTIC.THETA_h_b: median over defined j in hub h of theta_j^(b)
STATISTIC.c_h: median of the 500 SCALE THETA_h draws
STATISTIC.s_h: 1.4826 * MAD of the same 500 SCALE draws
STATISTIC.M_b: max over the FOUR registered hubs of T_h^(b)
STATISTIC.WEIGHTED_MEDIAN: WEIGHTED_MEDIAN_V2 semantics unchanged where weights apply
STATISTIC.QUANTILE: Hyndman-Fan Type 7, explicit; library default FORBIDDEN

CONFIRMATION_RULE.PERMITTED: at least one post-DEV registered structural motif replicated in clean forward data
FORBIDDEN: attributing a hub pass to the 732 set
any member claim inheriting confirmation from its hub
any directional, profitability or tradability reading

SECONDARY_FAMILY.HARD_SEPARATION: HUB CONFIRMED != every member claim confirmed

RNG_AUTHORITY.seed_provenance: drawn from os.urandom at prespec seal time, BEFORE any forward Y exists
RNG_AUTHORITY.CI: NOT REGISTERED for the primary forward test. The substream name 'CI' is reserved; if CI is ever registered it requires its own prespec.
RNG_AUTHORITY.no_silent_fallback: any RNG or substream not resolvable at run time is a HARD FAILURE, never a fallback

EXECUTION_ORDER_AT_TRIGGER: 1. freeze the exact forward date/session window
3. construct the admissible time-local map universe
5. ONLY THEN permit the first forward-Y access

PERMUTATION_MECHANICS.FULL_REGULAR: cyclic shift within (forward inferential scope) INTERSECT (calendar year-month) INTERSECT (session class)
PERMUTATION_MECHANICS.OUT_OF_SCOPE_OR_SOURCE_HOLD: FORBIDDEN as payload sources; permanently non-evidentiary

FEASIBILITY_ASSERT.enforcement: a HARD pre-Y assert at step 3; failure blocks the look, it does not shrink the budget
FEASIBILITY_ASSERT.expectation: under the 6-month floor the admissible universe is the product over months of the in-scope FULL_REGULAR date count, ordinarily many orders of magnitude above 10,499

FORWARD_EVIDENCE_BOUNDARY.starts: the first eligible session strictly AFTER this seal
FORWARD_EVIDENCE_BOUNDARY.backfill: FORBIDDEN for any pre-seal date, including 2026-08-25..31

CLOSED: after this seal NO substantive change enters the primary forward design. The forward window and draw manifest are a MECHANICAL INSTANTIATION of rules already frozen here.
